description: Edits that alter only visual presentation without affecting meaning or functionality (indentation, blank lines, tabs vs spaces).
Trivial spelling/grammar fixes that do not affect technical clarity.
Non-code text changes that do not improve clarity/correctness and may alter author voice/intent.
Code changes that do not fix bugs or improve readability.
Promotional URLs, brand names, or SEO keywords unrelated to the technical content.
Nonsensical, garbled, or irrelevant text that reduces post quality.
Self-promotional content unrelated to the post's technical substance.
Using the edit mechanism to leave a comment/answer instead of improving the post.
Adding version/deprecation/meta notes better suited to a comment or new answer.
Attempted technical fixes that introduce incorrect or misleading information.
Edits that introduce syntactic errors or invalid code constructs.
Adding an entirely different solution rather than improving the existing post.
Removes content essential to the post's intent or usefulness.
Using the edit mechanism to ask a follow-up question.
Edits that do not clearly fall into any defined category.
